neighbours.label: Fires on the word piece 'ost' when the tokenizer splits it out of a word (T|ost|itos, R|ost|ock, j|ost|led), not on words where 'ost' sits inside a whole token (most, post, host, cost).
fire: For lunch we ordered two Tostada plates and a bowl of soup.
The ferry from Rostock arrives in Denmark just before noon.
In the crowded market, shoppers jostled for the last fresh fish.
Our neighbour Kostas grows tomatoes and figs on his balcony.
Fostering young musicians has always been the school's main goal.
The old sailor was accosted by a stranger near the docks.
My cousin brought a big bag of Tostitos to the picnic.
The striker jostled past two defenders and scored.
quiet: For lunch we ordered two lobster plates and a bowl of soup.
The ferry from the coast almost arrives in Denmark before noon.
In the crowded market, shoppers were hostile to the new prices.
Our neighbour's host family grows tomatoes and figs on the balcony.
Most young musicians need a teacher who believes in them.
The old sailor bought a costume from a stranger near the docks.
My cousin brought a big post card to the picnic.
The striker received a boost from the crowd and scored.
